title: Final residual notice disposition and font identification
body:
# Final disposition supplement for [HEX-189](/HEX/issues/HEX-189)

Mindi's final dispositions in [HEX-194](/HEX/issues/HEX-194) are authoritative for this additive handoff. Interaction 19ce39e0-773c-4060-8c7f-d5f001acc9c5 was withdrawn with a link to that courier. This completes the notice research/disposition task with residuals preserved; it does not assert full source, license or release closure.

## Dispositions

- Ship the rows in DECLARED-ONLY.md / declared-only-rows.json with the literal disclosure "declared license only; upstream notice text not found". Upstream root grants remain missing. No invented holders or SPDX templates. Optional private pg0/cobble research does not block P9; no upstream filings.
- Keep gsap 3.15.0, classified proprietary-permissive (not open source), per Mindi. Exact package README, package.json and license statement are included. **There is no standalone LICENSE or complete license text in the package**: gsap-provenance.json records this. Previously captured linked standard terms are separate upstream HTML plus explicitly derived plain text, not package bytes.
- Codi, [HEX-193](/HEX/issues/HEX-193): exclude the bundled Claude binary, provide official-channel operator installation; exclude @photon-ai/whatsapp-business 0.1.1 and disable/gate that path. Its missing declaration is not turned into a declared-only shipping grant.
- Nous code is declared-only. The 14 bundled font files identify Collapse, Rules Compressed/Expanded, Mondwest and PP NeueBit. These have proprietary commercial licensing, not established OFL grants. Image redistribution entitlement is absent. Codi applies Mindi's fallback: replace with system/OFL fonts and verify absence of the old bytes. See FONTS.md.
- Opi, [HEX-192](/HEX/issues/HEX-192): Docker ownership proof, 30 npm path/integrity joins or proven absence, and FFmpeg/Chrome/Claude provenance. Codi handles FFmpeg/Chrome remediation in [HEX-193](/HEX/issues/HEX-193) and integrates under [HEX-181](/HEX/issues/HEX-181).
- Accepted P9 known limitations: manylinux vendored source gaps, s6 musl toolchain, cua/pg0 linkage, native bindings/esbuild and TOFU identity. Preserve source-lock supersets, post-release caveats, original membership and source_status: not_reconciled. The previous 60 residual records are retained verbatim in prior-residual-review.json; their historical "pending decision" wording is superseded only by this decision record, never by fabricated evidence.
- Devi joins later [HEX-192](/HEX/issues/HEX-192) results in a separate assigned follow-up; [HEX-189](/HEX/issues/HEX-189) need not remain open.

## Integration and verification

Add beside the existing hex189 supplement and reconciliation update; preserve their bytes. This is an artifact handoff to Codi, not a code change to the hexorx repository. Codi owns feature PR, independent exact-head review, CI and any eventual merge. No image push, deploy, public filing, spend or data deletion occurred. Rollback: omit this additive supplement or normally revert its integration commit.

Verification: 14 declared-only package/version rows retain their baseline identities; GSAP npm SHA512 integrity and SHA256 match; Nous SHA256 matches prior evidence; all 28 font paths inspected, 14 src/dist byte pairs equal; metadata decoded for every font; prior residual file copied byte-for-byte; SHA256SUMS and archive round-trip verified. No application code changed; application build/lint/tests are not applicable.

# Nous UI font identification and disposition

Exact @nous-research/ui 0.18.2 archive contains 28 font paths, representing 14 distinct files: identical src/dist pairs. All font name/copyright/version records were read with fontkit; hashes, names and exact paths are in font-identification.json. No package LICENSE was found.

| Family | Bundled styles | Identified rights source | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Collapse | Thin, Thin Italic, Light, Light Italic, Regular, Italic, Bold, Bold Italic | Blaze Type / Keussel, embedded copyright 2023; proprietary commercial licensing | Replace |
| Rules Compressed | Regular, Medium | Blaze Type / Matthieu Salvaggio / Léon Hugues, embedded copyright 2022; proprietary commercial licensing | Replace |
| Rules Expanded | Regular, Bold | Same Rules rights source | Replace |
| Mondwest | Regular | Pangram Pangram Foundry, embedded copyright 2020; proprietary commercial licensing | Replace |
| PP NeueBit | Bold | Pangram Pangram Foundry, embedded copyright 2020; proprietary commercial licensing | Replace |

Primary references (consulted 2026-09-30): [Collapse](https://blazetype.eu/typefaces/collapse/), [Rules](https://blazetype.eu/typefaces/rules/), [Blaze EULA](https://blazetype.eu/eula/), [Blaze license categories](https://blazetype.eu/license/), [Pangram bitmap font pack](https://pangrampangram.com/products/bitmap-fonts).

These are not established OFL fonts. Foundry identification and commercial licensing do not establish that this package has rights to redistribute them in an image. No qualifying image redistribution grant was supplied. Per Mindi's authorized fallback, Codi replaces every listed font with system fonts or independently verified OFL alternatives in [HEX-193](/HEX/issues/HEX-193), including CSS references and copies in src/dist/build outputs. Check the final image and distributable layers for all 14 hashes; a CSS-only change is insufficient. Font licensing residual stays open until replacement evidence lands. No purchase or upstream contact is required.
